numbers.name: constraint_preservation_points_within_1e-10
numbers.value: 20/20; fails without the F' R term

note: Flat FRW, kappa = 1, dust plus psi, radiation neglected; portal force on cosmological psi dropped (for g_c within the T016 bound it is below 1e-24 of the potential force, AI estimate). Apparent dark energy defined with today's G = 1/(8 pi F0). Scan numbers come from uet_frw_background.report() on an AI grid (xi = +-0.003..0.05, psi_i = 0.1..1, m/H0 = 1..3, 135 runs; allowed = Cassini |gamma - 1| < 2.3e-5, LLR |dG/dt/G| < 2.2e-3 H0, xi outside the T001 interval); the deepest dip is a lower bound on the allowed depth, measured within 0.25 <= a <= 1, with CPL fits over 0.4 <= a <= 1 (AI windows). xi = 0 cannot go below w = -1 (identity rho_DE + p_DE = pi^2). Nearest theory: thawing and extended quintessence. Not UET-distinct and not compared with BAO or supernova data; that needs a Test Card approved by the author.
